For all answers, state clearly any results from the module that you use.

## Question 1: Separable equations

Solve the initial value problem
$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = x y^2, \quad y(0) = 1,
$$
and state the largest interval containing $x = 0$ on which the solution exists.

## Question 2: Linear equations

(a) Find the general solution of $\dot{x}(t) + 2 x(t) = \mathrm{e}^{-t}$.

(b) Describe the behaviour of every solution as $t \to \infty$.
